purpose: Separate facts, inferences and judgments and bind consequential claims to evidence.
hard_gates: Unsupported facts, private patterns without public proof and unresolved consequential claims block.
soft_gates: The strongest credible objection should be visible when evidence remains contestable.

failure.fallback: Narrow the claim, obtain public evidence or remove the unsupported candidate from production.

regression_cases: An internal pattern cannot become a factual script claim without public evidence.
A verified fact cannot have an empty evidence ledger.
